_doc: Error code registry (C681, design/33). retryable: may be tried again later; exit: the process exit code a command reports for it (30 data not there yet, 75 source unavailable, 40 final, 64 configuration, 20 satisfied). 'pending' lists codes already in use as string literals that have not been classified yet; each needs a decision before the expiry.

ALREADY_SATISFIED.meaning: nothing to do: the result already exists (a skip, not a failure)

APPLY_ITEM_FAILED.meaning: the start-up/reconcile plan was applied but some items failed (each failed row carries its own code); the next pass applies the remaining ones

BAOSTOCK_CONNECTION_ERROR.meaning: Baostock connection failed or was cut

BAOSTOCK_GAP_UNRESOLVED.meaning: Baostock has not delivered the missing symbols yet; progress is kept, try again later

BAOSTOCK_LOCAL_GAP_WAIT.meaning: waiting for the local gap to close

CALENDAR_UNKNOWN.meaning: the trade calendar does not cover or know the date yet

CHAIN_FAILED.meaning: a node of a fetch chain failed for good

CHAIN_RETRY.meaning: a node of a fetch chain reported a retryable failure; the sweep tries again next pass

COMMAND_ARGUMENT_ERROR.meaning: a command line argument is wrong

CONTRACT_ERROR.meaning: the function broke its reply contract

CONTRACT_INVALID.meaning: the request or reply is not valid under the contract

CONTRACT_VIOLATION.meaning: a (exit code, reply) pair outside the contract matrix

DAILY_KLINE_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED.meaning: the time budget of a daily-kline run ran out; progress is kept, the next attempt continues

DAILY_KLINE_NOT_READY.meaning: waiting for the FORMAL Baostock daily bars of the day

DDE_SYNC_INCOMPLETE_RETRYABLE.meaning: DDE sync finished part of the symbols

DDE_SYNC_RETRYABLE.meaning: DDE sync could not finish for a retryable reason

DEPENDENCY_FAILED.meaning: a dependency of the fetch item failed; the item waits for it

DETERMINISTIC_FAILURE.meaning: a failure that repeating will not change

EXECUTION_SETUP_FAILED.meaning: a job could not set itself up (a source it needs before running was unavailable)

FETCH_JOB_UNAVAILABLE.meaning: the registry names no independent fetch job for the item

FETCH_TIMEOUT.meaning: a fetch exceeded its time budget

INTERNAL_ERROR.meaning: the handler's catch-all for an exception nobody classified; not a contract exit code, never raised on purpose

KAIPAN_LIMIT_DETAIL_WAITING.meaning: Kaipan limit-up detail is not complete yet

KAIPAN_PLATE_MEMBERS_INCOMPLETE.meaning: Kaipan plate members came back incomplete

LIMIT_UP_DETAIL_FAILED.meaning: the limit-up detail build failed for a reason repeating will not change

PLAN_UNAVAILABLE.meaning: the reconcile plan could not be built (an input it reads was unavailable); the plan is rebuilt on the next pass

POSTCONDITION_FAILED.meaning: the function reported success but its declared postcondition does not hold

PREOPEN_CHECK_FAILED.meaning: a pre-open check found a missing input; its own producers retry

PREP_CRITICAL_MISSING.meaning: a critical pre-market step has no data and the prep run cannot make it appear (the fetch_item repair queue owns the repair); repeating the prep does not help

PREVIOUS_TRADE_DAY_UNAVAILABLE.meaning: the previous trading day cannot be determined yet

PROVIDER_BLOCKED.meaning: the provider's circuit is open (blocked); do not call it again in this window

Q2_POOL_EMPTY_INCOMPLETE.meaning: the q2 pool is empty/incomplete in a way the snapshot cannot repair

Q2_READ_FAILED.meaning: the q2 snapshot could not be read this time

Q2_SNAPSHOT_INVALID.meaning: the q2 snapshot is invalid (timestamps / shape)

Q2_UNAVAILABLE.meaning: the q2 Redis snapshot cannot be read

QUALITY_INVALID.meaning: the data fails a quality rule (empty, duplicate keys, universe jump ...; reason says which); not fixed by repeating

RATE_LIMITED.meaning: the source or the local budget refuses another request for now

SCHEMA_INVALID.meaning: the data has a shape the function does not accept (reason says which); fetching again returns the same shape

SOURCE_DATE_EVIDENCE_INCOMPLETE.meaning: the source did not prove the date of its rows yet

SOURCE_UNREADABLE.meaning: a source could not be read

STALL_NO_PROGRESS.meaning: the fill made no progress within its window; progress is kept

TD_FOREIGN_LONG_QUERY.meaning: another process has held a TD query for a long time (reported, not an error of this function)

TD_CORE_LONG_QUERY.meaning: a TD query of Core itself has been running for a long time (reported; the query is Core's own defect to fix, the check never kills it)

TD_MEMORY_HEADROOM_LOW.meaning: the host leaves little room for TD's query memory pool (available memory minus TDengine's documented reserve, an estimate); 0x073a is likely until it grows

TD_REQUIRES_BAOSTOCK.meaning: TD daily bars only accept Baostock rows; the Baostock version is not there yet

TD_RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED.meaning: TDengine query memory is exhausted (another process holds the pool, 0x073a); later is fine

TD_UNAVAILABLE.meaning: TDengine cannot be reached or refused the statement

TD_VERIFY_FAILED.meaning: the TD read-back differs from the catalog version: the day is not complete (TdVerifyError); repeating the write does not change what was written

TD_WRITE_FAILED.meaning: the TD write did not complete and was not retried by the writer

TIER_DATE_MISMATCH.meaning: the data is for another day

TIER_NO_DATA.meaning: the tier has no data for the day and never will

TIER_PARTIAL.meaning: a tier delivered only part of the day; resume on the next attempt

UNKNOWN_ITEM.meaning: the plan or request names an item the registry does not know; repeating does not help

UPSTREAM_ERROR.meaning: an upstream request failed (Kaipan pool and similar); try again later

UPSTREAM_NOT_READY.meaning: an input this function needs is not published yet (reason carries which, e.g. DAILY_KLINE_MISSING)

WENCAI_BLOCKED.meaning: WenCai refused the request (rate gate / 403 breaker); later is fine

WENCAI_POOL_EMPTY_UNVERIFIED.meaning: WenCai returned an empty pool that cannot be verified

WENCAI_THROTTLED.meaning: the daily WenCai budget is spent

WENCAI_WINDOW_CLOSED.meaning: the WenCai confirmation window is not open

pending.reason: in use as literals before the registry existed. Still open: ALL_SOURCES_FAILED and COVERAGE_LOW (data fields whose retryability depends on the caller), NOT_CONFIGURED / NO_CATALOG_DAYS (exit 20 with a code other than ALREADY_SATISFIED: a contract question for td_sync), TD_SYNC_ERROR (a nested sink status).
